subject: ADR-212: three buttons handed the reader a file the published kit cannot deliver, and told them it had arrived
body: This kit is READ AS PUBLISHED ARTIFACTS, and every audit in it drives docs/ from a file:// URL in a browser this container owns, where a page-started download works. The published page runs in a sandboxed frame that does not permit one: a.click() on a blob: URL returns nothing, throws nothing and downloads nothing. Three controls -- the breeding bench's and the cp bench's Download bench.csv, and the experiment guide's Download .eco -- handed their payload over by download and by NO OTHER ROUTE, so in the kit as anyone actually reads it all three did nothing, and all three said they had. AND THE KIT HAD ALREADY WORKED THIS OUT: two of the three carry a comment saying word for word that a hosted viewer can refuse a page-started download silently -- no throw, no return value, nothing to test -- so a mark there would be the exact ADR-203 defect one layer along. That reasoning is right and it was acted on: the outbox is deliberately not marked on a download. Four lines further down the same handler raised toast('bench.csv downloaded'). The ledger was made truthful and the thing the reader actually reads was not. ADR-138's shape in a different channel -- every audit measures docs/, and docs/ was fine. tools/audit_takeaway.py presses every control audit_outputs counts as one that hands something over, asked rather than copied, and reads the payloads by CHANNEL: clipboard, copy and print survive publication because each reports failure or opens the reader's own dialog; a download cannot. STRANDED is a ratchet per page; CLAIMS is not one, because a page telling a reader their sheet is saved when it is not is what this kit exists to refuse. A HEDGED MESSAGE IS NOT A CLAIM. WHAT THE PAGE SAID IS THIS PRESS'S -- the door SPLICES the live-region log when it reports what an act said, and the first draft read it afterwards and found three stranded controls and zero liars. All three still attempt the download and now also put the bytes on the clipboard, saying which of the two the reader can count on. verify_takeaway 28 over six fixtures, mutate_takeaway 19 with no known equivalents. 3 of 81 stranded and 3 claims, to 0 and 0.
